title: IMS Component Schema
description: Parameter definitions for IMS (Item Management System) custom recognitions/actions. Referenced by custom.recognition.schema.json / custom.action.schema.json.

AddItemDataParam.title: AddItemData Param
AddItemDataParam.description: Parameters for AddItemData action (A3). Sequentially runs recognition nodes and adds OCR quantities into the IMS cache as positive deltas. Does not change readiness / last_sync. Misses and non-positive quantities are skipped. When items is omitted or empty, uses the full a3 map from assets/data/IMS/items.json. Best practice: use under CloseRewardsButton recognition, then next to click-close the rewards UI; custom_action_param may be {}.

items.title: Items
items.description: Optional map of item ID -> recognition node name. When omitted or empty, load the full a3 catalog from data/IMS/items.json. Keys are cache IDs; values are run in sorted key order. Quantity comes from each node's box_index OCR result and is added to cache.

mask_hit_region.title: Mask Hit Region
mask_hit_region.description: A3 only. After each successful item hit, paint that item's on-screen region green (RGB 0,255,0) on the working screenshot and keep recognizing the same item ID until no more hits. Fixes dual stacks on one reward popup (e.g. base 100 + bonus 15). Default true when omitted.

ItemDataReadyParam.title: ItemDataReady Param
ItemDataReadyParam.description: Parameters for ItemDataReady recognition. Reports whether the in-process inventory cache is ready (has a successful sync and is within TTL).

refresh_days.title: Refresh Days
refresh_days.description: Cache TTL in days after a successful sync. 1 / 7 / 30 expire after that many days; 0 means never expire due to age (still requires hasData). Omit to default to 7.

ItemQuantitySatisfiedParam.title: ItemQuantitySatisfied Param
ItemQuantitySatisfiedParam.description: Parameters for ItemQuantitySatisfied recognition (R1). Evaluates a boolean expression over one or more cached item IDs via {ITEM_ID} placeholders (same operators as ExpressionRecognition). Does not check readiness; combine with ItemDataReady via And when needed. Missing item counts as 0. UI Focus announce is off by default.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Boolean expression over cached item quantities. Use {ITEM_ID} placeholders (missing item = 0). Supports + - * / % < <= > >= == != && || ! and parentheses. Result must be boolean.

notify_ui.title: Notify UI
notify_ui.description: When true, print the resolved expression to UI Focus (throttled). Default false.

UpdateItemQuantityParam.title: UpdateItemQuantity Param
UpdateItemQuantityParam.description: Parameters for UpdateItemQuantity action (A1). Applies a signed delta to one cached item; result is clamped to >= 0. Persists IMS.json but does not change readiness / last_sync (only SyncItemData marks sync).

item.title: Item
item.description: Item ID (same keys as SyncItemData items / IMS.json).

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: Signed quantity change (positive gain, negative spend).

SyncItemDataParam.title: SyncItemData Param
SyncItemDataParam.description: Scan And recognizers on the current screen. items maps item ID to recognition node name; quantity is read from that node's box_index OCR child. A2 requires an explicit items map (no items.json default). Results are written to debug/record/IMS.json with updated_at.

items.title: Items
items.description: Required map of item ID -> And recognition node name. Keys are stored as cache IDs; values are run in sorted key order. Quantity comes from each node's box_index OCR result. Include fixed OCR nodes (e.g. T_CREDS_NUMBER) when needed for the current screen.

page_dedup.title: Page Dedup
page_dedup.description: When false (default), rebuild only the item IDs listed in this scan's items map (misses are removed for those IDs); other cached IDs from other regions are preserved. When true, merge into existing cache and overwrite quantities for hit IDs (used after paging).

notify_ui.title: Notify UI
notify_ui.description: When true (default), print each hit item name and quantity to UI Focus (ims.sync_item_found). Set false for silent scans (e.g. scene-jump side-cache).
